text_blocks.snippet: Common side effects of losartan include dizziness, fatigue, upper respiratory infections, and mild stomach upset.
snippet_highlighted_words: dizziness, fatigue, upper respiratory infections, and mild stomach upset

text_blocks.snippet: You can review comprehensive data on Losartan via MedlinePlus or check the detailed NHS Losartan Guide for more patient information. Additional clinical descriptions are maintained by the Mayo Clinic Drug Directory.

list.snippet: Dizziness or lightheadedness: Happens when your blood pressure drops, especially when standing up quickly.
Fatigue: Feeling more tired than usual as your body adapts to lower blood pressure.
Upper respiratory symptoms: Stuffiness, nasal congestion, or signs of a common cold.
Digestive issues: Mild nausea, vomiting, diarrhea, or stomach pain.
Aches and pains: Back pain or occasional joint pain.
Headache: Mild head pain during the initial adjustment phase.
High potassium levels (Hyperkalemia): May cause muscle weakness or an irregular heartbeat, though it often has no symptoms.
Low blood pressure (Hypotension): Can lead to fainting, confusion, or blurred vision.
Kidney function changes: May show up as decreased urination or swelling in the hands, ankles, or feet.
Allergic reaction (Angioedema): Rare swelling of the face, lips, tongue, or throat, which makes breathing or swallowing difficult.
